AppFunctionAppMetadata.app:instructions: NoteMark stores the user's text notes. Each note has an id, a title and a content. To change an existing note, first call findNotes to get its id, then call updateNote with that id. updateNote replaces the content: to append text, call getNote, combine the old and new text, and pass the result. findNotes returns only a preview of each note's content; call getNote for the full text. If a function reports that the user is not logged in, ask them to open NoteMark and log in.
